name: MUTATION
text: Free strategic gambit: mutate up to two cult operatives in the first and second turning points, three in the third and four after that. Each mutation turns a Devotee into a Mutant, a Mutant into a Torment, or heals up to D3+1 wounds.

name: EXALTATION IN PAIN
text: This turning point, friendly cult operatives' weapons ignore the Hit change from being injured (Move is still reduced). A wounded friendly cult operative shot at may re-roll one defence die.

name: FERVENT ONSLAUGHT
text: This turning point, friendly cult operatives' melee weapons have Accurate 1, or Accurate 2 for Mutants and Torments.

name: CREATURES OF NIGHTMARE
text: This turning point, when marker control is worked out, the enemy's contesting total counts 1 lower if any contesting enemy is within 2" of a friendly Mutant or Torment.

name: SICKENING AURA
text: This turning point, an enemy within 2" of a friendly Mutant or Torment has the Hit of its weapons worsened by 1, not on top of the injury worsen.

name: FAITHFUL FOLLOWER
text: When a friendly DARK COMMUNE operative is picked as a Shoot target or Fight opponent, a friendly cult operative (not DARK COMMUNE) visible to and within 3" of it takes its place, valid or not. In a Fight it counts as in the fighter's control range; in a Shoot it is in cover or obscured only if the original target was. No effect against Blast or Torrent.

name: ABHORRENT MUTATION
text: As a friendly cult operative that is not DARK COMMUNE is activated, give it an Accursed Gift nobody has selected this battle. It keeps the gift if it turns into another operative, and cannot be picked for this ploy again.

name: FRENZIED DEMISE
text: When a friendly Mutant or Torment is incapacitated, before it is removed, one enemy operative visible to and within 2" of it takes D3 damage (D6 for a Torment).

name: UNLEASH THE DAEMON
text: During a friendly Mutant or Torment's activation, before or after an action: for the rest of that activation it may Fight twice, one of the Fights free.

name: BALEFUL SCRIPT
text: The strategic gambit that the BALEFUL SCRIPT equipment unlocks (once per battle): change one of your Accursed Gifts to a gift nobody has selected. Only offered to a team that took the equipment.

name: COVERT GUISES
text: The strategic gambit that the COVERT GUISES equipment unlocks (turning point 1 only): the D3 rolled for the equipment says how many Devotees wholly in your drop zone may make a free Reposition that ends wholly within 3" of it. Only offered to a team that took the equipment.
